pooled_pairwise_bootstrap.pairing: elementwise canonical pooled raw samples from identical state/hand identities

rank_2_omission.absolute_score: max over domains of pooled mean omission
rank_2_omission.current_best: minimum absolute_score, lexical candidate id only for deterministic reference when means are exactly equal
rank_2_omission.challenger_worst_domain: domain with larger challenger pooled mean omission; exact ties use lexical domain id
rank_2_omission.paired_difference: challenger omission minus current-best omission on challenger_worst_domain
rank_2_omission.discard_if: paired difference mean > 0.001 AND paired 95% CI lower bound > 0

rank_3_crossplay.absolute_score: min over domains of pooled mean paired crossplay score
rank_3_crossplay.current_best: maximum absolute_score, lexical candidate id only for deterministic reference when means are exactly equal
rank_3_crossplay.challenger_worst_domain: domain with smaller challenger pooled mean crossplay; exact ties use lexical domain id
rank_3_crossplay.paired_difference: current-best crossplay minus challenger crossplay on challenger_worst_domain
rank_3_crossplay.discard_if: paired difference mean > 0.001 AND paired 95% CI lower bound > 0

rank_4_nodes.keep_if: score <= best_score * 1.10; if best_score=0 keep exact zero only

rank_5_seconds.keep_if: score <= best_score * 1.10; if best_score=0 keep exact zero only

level_rules.160: no rank-7 fallback; output rank1-6 survivors for 320
level_rules.320: select only if exactly one rank1-6 survivor; otherwise output survivors for 640
level_rules.640: if multiple rank1-6 survivors remain, choose PF0_CONTROL_33_75_AI if eligible, otherwise lexical id

mandatory_next_level_execution.winner_eligibility: only candidates in the prior level survivor set; control/referee reruns do not resurrect pruned candidates
